subject: Discovery follow-up: technical deep dive / demo with Acme Cloud

Subject: Discovery follow-up: technical deep dive / demo availability

Hi Jordan 

Thanks again for the call earlier  great to learn more about Acme Cloud's ingestion pipeline and latency targets. Quick recap and proposed next step:

Recap
- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood Inference for production LLM inference serving (30k reqs/day, 100k tokens/day burst pattern)
- Key constraints: sub-200ms p95 for short responses, strict data separation for production workloads, SOC2 evidence request expected
- Next step: 30-45m technical deep dive + demo where we walk architecture, latency benchmarks, and deployment options

Proposed times (PT)  please pick one that works for your team:
- Tue Feb 16, 10:00 AM PT
- Wed Feb 17, 1:00 PM PT
- Thu Feb 18, 11:00 AM PT

Attendees to invite from your side: Jordan Smith (you), Priya Patel (engineering), Liam O'Neill (security/compliance)  please confirm or add others. From our side I suggest myself and Priyom Das (solutions engineer).

I've attached a short agenda and the requirements sheet we discussed for reference. Once you confirm a time and attendee list I'll send a calendar invite with a Meet link (or Zoom if you prefer).

Attachments: acme_requirements.xlsx

Next steps
- Confirm preferred time and attendee list
- I'll send the calendar invite and agenda

Thanks,
